system.description:
You've trained your Pokemon in the way of the Duelist.

As a simple action costing 2PP, you may designate one member of your Team (or another ally, if combined with @UUID[Compendium.ptr2e.core-perks.13JRGGWEpyfuZZuG]{Tactician}) and one enemy as Duel Partners, both gaining the @Affliction[duel] Affliction for 3 activations.

If used during a League Combat Rules scenario, this may be used as a @Trait[command] Action in the same way as Styles are.
